dedupe_keys.name: optimization of the fuel economy and emissions for plug in hybrid electric recreational boat energy management strategy using genetic algorithm

description: J. S. Norbakyah and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented MATLAB/Simulink model optimises energy management for a hybrid recreational boat using a genetic algorithm. Evaluation uses the stated KT river operating cycle and reports a fifteen-percent improvement for its model comparison. The value is specific to the defined cycle and comparator; it does not establish observed fleet-wide fuel savings. This supports simulation of an inland-waterway vessel energy-management model, with source-code distribution and physical onboard deployment unspecified in the inspected metadata. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
